topic: Itachi spared Sasuke because Sasuke was the one person he could not kill and the plan he trusted
title: Why Itachi Could Never Kill Sasuke
description: Itachi wiped out the Uchiha clan and still let Sasuke live. Here's why I think that was the whole plan from the start. Was Itachi a hero or a monster?
comment: Was Itachi a hero or a monster? Pick one.

lines.text: Why did Itachi wipe out his whole clan and still let Sasuke live?

shot.fallback: stern young ninja with a red glowing eye

lines.text: Everyone says it was just mercy. I think it was way more calculated.

shot.fallback: older brother standing over a child in the dark

lines.text: Konoha's leaders had ordered him to end the Uchiha before they could rebel.

shot.fallback: burning ninja clan district at night

lines.text: The whole clan, and Itachi was the one holding the blade.

shot.fallback: ninja silhouette in a bloodless red moonlit street

lines.text: But Sasuke was the one thing he wouldn't give them.

shot.fallback: child ninja kneeling in front of his brother

lines.text: So he told Sasuke to hate him, and to come back for his eyes.

shot.search: Itachi tells Sasuke to hate him
shot.fallback: shadowy figure whispering to a child

lines.text: That hatred kept Sasuke alive, and it kept him focused on one target.

shot.fallback: boy ninja with burning red eyes

lines.text: Years later, Itachi is dying, and he still fights Sasuke like a wall he wants to be broken by.

shot.fallback: two ninjas facing off across a dark hideout

lines.text: The last thing he does is tap Sasuke's forehead one more time.

shot.fallback: older brother touching a younger brother's forehead

lines.text: That's not a villain saying goodbye. That's a brother who never let go.

shot.fallback: brothers under a soft glowing sky

lines.text: So maybe he never chose the village over Sasuke.

shot.fallback: ninja looking at a distant village with his brother
